STRICT_VERIFICATION: STRICT VERIFICATION (client instruction, 12 Nov 2026): zero tolerance for invented content. Every case name, citation, date, bench, section number, rule, notification, rate, time limit and quote must be confirmed from at least two independent sources opened in this run (court or official site plus a reliable reporter such as Live Law, Bar and Bench, SCC Online blog, Indian Kanoon, India Code, official gazettes). If a fact cannot be confirmed twice, leave it out or say plainly that it varies or is unsettled. Do not cite a case you have not opened. Do not generalise a High Court ruling into a nationwide rule. State the date as on which the law is described. Record every source URL in the draft's sources field. When in doubt, drop the item and write another.

AUDIENCE_FOCUS: AUDIENCE FOCUS (client instruction, 13 Nov 2026). NO new practice areas: use only the firm's existing practice areas (the exact names listed in the prompt) and aim each item at a question that one of four audiences actually searches: (1) NRIs/OCIs, (2) foreign nationals, (3) foreign companies and their Indian subsidiaries or branches, (4) high-net-worth individuals and family businesses. At least 2 of every 3 items in a run must clearly serve one of these audiences; the rest may serve domestic readers in Delhi NCR or Kolkata. Subject matters by existing practice area. NRI/OCI: Property & Civil Litigation (title checks, power of attorney, mutation, encroachment, partition, sale of inherited property, repatriating sale proceeds), Family Law (cross-border divorce, custody, maintenance, marriage registration), Tax Litigation (TDS on property sale by non-residents, residency status, DTAA, capital gains notices), Banking & Finance (NRE/NRO/FCNR accounts, loans, FEMA limits), Real Estate & RERA (delayed possession, complaint from abroad), Commercial Litigation (recovering money lent, service of summons abroad), Employment & Labour (EPF, gratuity, pension on leaving India). Foreign nationals and foreign companies: Corporate Law & M&A (subsidiary vs branch vs liaison office, FDI and FEMA filings, resident director rule, exit and winding up), Arbitration & Dispute Resolution (choosing the seat, enforcing foreign awards, interim relief in India), Commercial Litigation (suing or being sued in India, commercial courts, pre-institution mediation, injunctions), Intellectual Property (trademark registration, passing off, patents, trade secrets), Tax Litigation (GST on cross-border supply, TDS on payments abroad, permanent establishment, transfer pricing), Employment & Labour (hiring, labour codes, POSH, non-compete), IBC & Insolvency (foreign creditor claims, cross-border insolvency), Banking & Finance (ECB, FDI reporting, guarantees), Infrastructure & PPP and Power, Energy & Mining (foreign investor contracts, PPA and concession disputes), Food Safety & FSSAI (import licensing and labelling), Consumer Protection (e-commerce rules for foreign sellers).
